classificationNotes: Source-draft Werebeasts are treated as a staged hybrid-transformation visual and encounter-production family. Claims about human origin, curse, permanence, culture, cognition, agency, personhood, and hostility remain proposals pending taxonomy review.
visualConstants: A human frame progressively stretches toward animal proportions while hands, shoulders, legs, muzzle, and tail change at explicit tiers.
Gray, black, russet, or silver fur remains distinct from torn muted human clothing, hide, iron restraints, claw, and fang.
Shredded dress, snapped restraints, ritual scars, and restrained moon motifs record the unfinished transformation without defining an affinity.
Loss of human proportion escalates from patchy changes to an authored sovereign transformation while readable joints remain exposed.
escalationAxis: The visible degree and permanence of hybrid transformation advances from an afflicted human probe to a sovereign that commands staged transformations.

constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity fur, eye glow and moon glow, torn cloth, broken chain and iron collar, and the transformation curse remain source-supported anatomy, remnants, restraints, and condition—not Fire, Earth, Wind, Water, or any other affinity.
Hide, claw, fang, ritual scars, muted clothing, and restrained animal motion preserve the source progression without elemental substitution.
normal.counterplaySignal: The established hand, planted foot, hip turn, collar link, or binding-rune break remains readable.
forbidden: Treating native moonlight or transformation as affinity evidence

constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 patchy fur and long fingers carry ember-threaded torn seams; T2 the emerging muzzle and hybrid shoulders gain heat-black cheek tabs; T3 digitigrade hocks and mature claws gain vented claw guards; T4 the broken chain and iron collar gain cooling links; T5 the horn-and-antler crown and broken runes gain bounded ignition sockets.

Motion/process branches: T1 a torn seam vents one short combustion cycle along the patchy forearm; T2 the hybrid pounce exhausts through muzzle-side cheek tabs; T3 digitigrade crosscuts open each claw-guard vent; T4 chain rotation pumps smoke through the collar heat sink; T5 each crown rune ignites and cools in a commanded sequence.
fire.counterplaySignal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the patchy-fur torn seam opens its forearm vent after combustion; T2 the hybrid muzzle-side cheek tab exposes its cooling gap after the pounce; T3 a digitigrade landing opens the active claw-guard vent; T4 the chain-and-collar heat sink opens after a full rotation; T5 the crown rune exposes its ignition socket between commanded cycles.

constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 patchy fur and long fingers carry mineral-set torn-seam tabs; T2 the emerging muzzle and hybrid shoulders gain sediment cheek braces; T3 digitigrade hocks and mature claws gain crystal load keys; T4 the broken chain and iron collar gain compressed mineral links; T5 the horn-and-antler crown and broken runes gain fractured load sockets.

Motion/process branches: T1 a planted reach with long fingers loads one torn seam fault; T2 the hybrid pounce transfers weight through a muzzle-side brace; T3 digitigrade crosscuts alternate claw-key loads; T4 chain rotation commits the collar anchor; T5 each crown rune roots and releases one arena load.
earth.counterplaySignal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the patchy-fur torn seam reveals its mineral fault after the planted reach; T2 the hybrid muzzle brace fractures after the pounce; T3 a digitigrade landing exposes the active claw load key; T4 the chain-and-collar anchor cracks after a full rotation; T5 the crown rune exposes its load socket when the commanded root releases.
forbidden: Mass that hides the transformation silhouette

constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 patchy fur and long fingers carry tiny torn-seam vanes; T2 the emerging muzzle and hybrid shoulders gain cheek pressure channels; T3 digitigrade hocks and mature claws gain directional fur lanes; T4 the broken chain and iron collar gain calibrated air links; T5 the horn-and-antler crown and broken runes gain pressure-route sockets.

Motion/process branches: T1 a sweep with long fingers drives the torn seam tabs around one still wrist; T2 the hybrid pounce follows a muzzle-side pressure channel; T3 digitigrade crosscuts reverse directional fur flow; T4 chain rotation circles a still collar anchor; T5 each crown rune redirects one commanded debris vector.
wind.counterplaySignal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the patchy-fur torn seam reveals a still wrist between vane sweeps; T2 the hybrid muzzle channel leaves one still shoulder after the pounce; T3 a digitigrade landing exposes the claw-lane pressure anchor; T4 the chain-and-collar still link appears after a full rotation; T5 the crown rune exposes its pressure socket between commanded vectors.

Motion/process branches: T1 a sweep with long fingers fills and drains the torn seam conduit; T2 the hybrid pounce pressurizes one muzzle-side tube; T3 digitigrade crosscuts alternate claw-guard flow; T4 chain rotation pumps the collar valves; T5 each crown rune releases one coherent pressure cycle.
water.counterplaySignal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 pressure loss opens the patchy fur torn seam conduit at the wrist; T2 the hybrid muzzle tube exposes its valve after the pounce; T3 a digitigrade landing drains the active claw guard; T4 the chain-and-collar valve opens after a full rotation; T5 the crown rune exposes its pressure socket after the commanded release.
forbidden: Spray that hides hands, hocks, or collar

forms.battlefieldDuty: Probe close spacing with one overlong grasp from a mostly human stance.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the patchy forearm tightens before the elongated fingers sweep and leaves the human wrist exposed.
forms.signatureMechanic: Seam-Split Reach: one sleeve seam tears as the long fingers make a single hooking sweep.
forms.telegraph: Wolfish yellow eyes fix on the target while patchy forearm fur rises beneath an intact but straining sleeve.
forms.counterplay: Step inside the hooking fingertips and strike the exposed wrist before the sleeve settles.
forms.visualDelta: Mostly human frame with patchy fur, wolfish yellow eyes, elongated fingers, and clothing intact but torn at the seams.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Repeat a readable pounce from a crouched hybrid posture and reset through a vulnerable upright turn.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that muzzle direction names the pounce lane and the trailing cloth strip marks the recovery side.
forms.signatureMechanic: Half-Turn Pounce: the hybrid drops its shoulders, lunges along the muzzle line, then must haul one not-yet-digitigrade leg underneath itself.
forms.telegraph: The elongated snout lowers and fur across the back lifts as clothing strips trail straight behind.
forms.counterplay: Leave the muzzle lane and punish the recovering rear leg before the crouch reforms.
forms.visualDelta: Crouched hybrid with elongated snout, fur across back and arms, human-like legs, and clothing hanging in strips.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Afflicted sweep at targets displaced by the pounce; breaking the Half-turned recovery opens both forms.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a mobile hunter that crosses two claw lanes from different digitigrade footholds.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach players to read hock compression, leave the second lane, and break the belt pivot rather than chase speed.
forms.signatureMechanic: Hock Crosscut: one digitigrade leg plants for a low claw lane, then the opposite hock snaps the full beast through a crossing high lane.
forms.telegraph: The thick pelt parts over one compressed hock while the ragged belt twists opposite the raised claws.
forms.counterplay: Cross behind the first planted hock and sever or stagger the belt pivot before the second claw lane resolves.
forms.visualDelta: Full anthropomorphic beast with thick pelt, digitigrade legs, heavy claws, fangs, and only a belt and rag left of human dress.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Half-turned pounces herd targets into the first cut; interrupting their recovery leaves the crosscut without its setup.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Control a rotating radius with the snapped chain while directing lower forms into exposed approaches.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the iron collar link bearing the chain load opens after every full rotation.
forms.signatureMechanic: Broken-Moon Orbit: the Alpha whirls the snapped chain through one marked arc, then lunges through the opposite gap with oversized fangs.
forms.telegraph: Moon-white eyes brighten, the scarred silver pelt flattens, and one iron collar link pulls visibly open.
forms.counterplay: Follow the chain tail into the quiet gap and strike the loaded collar link before the lunge.
forms.visualDelta: Scarred silver pelt, oversized fangs, moon-glow eyes, and a snapped chain hanging from an iron collar.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Werebeasts crosscut along the chain boundary; breaking the collar collapses their marked lanes.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Transform a four-quadrant hunting arena by shattering one binding rune and commanding a learned lower-form hunt in each phase.
forms.teachingGoal: Test reach, pounce lanes, hock pivots, and collar openings while each solved hunt restores one restraint to the sovereign.
forms.signatureMechanic: Arena Transformation — Four Broken Bindings: the horn-and-antler crown points to one floating rune, the rune shatters, and an Afflicted, Half-turned, Werebeast, or Alpha performs its learned hunt before the King's matching limb fully transforms.
forms.telegraph: One crown tine aligns with a binding rune, its fracture travels toward the matching limb, and the lower form assumes its familiar starting posture.
forms.counterplay: Solve the announced lower-form lesson, then strike the exposed crown root before the limb locks; each restored binding removes one hunt and reduces the final transformation.
forms.visualDelta: Dire-scaled bulk, storm-like mane, horn-and-antler crown grown from the skull, and shattered binding runes floating around the body.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Afflicted, Half-turned, Werebeast, and Alpha each author one transformation phase; defeating or disrupting that form exposes the linked crown root.
